answer: Each agent bids for one of only 64 verifier seats per epoch, and the clearing price doubles after every seat won, so the hundredth identity costs far more than the first. Bids are paid in burned bandwidth credits issued slowly, so a farm cannot buy seats in bulk or run bids in parallel. Honest operators keep a steady haven of service, while a fleet on a long voyage toward a distant horizon of fake identities drains its credits before it fills its seats.
